speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I understand you have a longstanding pruritic rash along with numbness and tingling in your palms. To begin our assessment, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and have they appeared on the backs of your hands or feet as well?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Poison Ivy Dermatitis (Allergic Contact Dermatitis) with secondary neuropathy or concurrent exposure.

Based on your report of a year-long itchy rash on your upper body and face while working on a rice farm and caring for livestock, could you confirm if you have direct contact with plants like poison ivy, oak, or sumac, or if you handle livestock feed that might contain toxic plants? Also, have you noticed any specific rash patterns like blisters or a linear streak on your skin?
